, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Historic Environment Scotland page by treating the 1207 cathedral designation as a precise founding year of the palace. The source actually indicates the bishops established their residence at Spynie in the late 1100s, so the correct founding timeframe is the late 12th century, not 1207.
